attack_primary.note_gallimimus: gallimimus (SP-GALLIMIMUS, tools/gait/make_galli_moves.py): beak peck, 1.0 s: the neck cocks into an S and whips the beak down onto her chest on 0.42 (a beak solver aims it at her spot)
attack_primary.note_therizinosaurus: therizinosaurus (SP-THERIZINOSAURUS, tools/gait/make_theri_moves.py): claw sweep, 1.0 s: the right arm cocks out to its right, the sickle claws sweep low across its front on 0.42 (hit from Claw.R); a landed sweep shoves her back (tactics.primary_shove_m)
attack_primary.note_raptorflank: raptor (RAPTORFLANK): tools/gait/raptor_overlay.py on the transferred clip: the hands grab forward with the claws spread and rake down clenched on each hit, the tail is keyed level (it flicked straight up); same timing and events

grab_bite.note: utahraptor (UTAHARMS 2026-10-31): its attack_primary with the hands reaching forward, claws spread, and raking down clenched on the bite (tools/gait/raptor_overlay.py --keep); same timing as attack_primary; TacticalBrain plays it for tactics.bite_alt_chance of the bites

attack_heavy.note_gallimimus: gallimimus: spring-and-rake kick, 1.42 s: the right leg hauled high and held trembling through windup_hold 0.6, snapped forward through her on 0.72 and raked back; hits from Toe.R, a stagger shove and Winded (no knockdown)
attack_heavy.note_raptor: raptor (SP-RAPTOR, make_raptor_moves.py): sickle slash, 1.42 s: rocks onto the left leg with the right foot hauled high and the claw cocked (held at windup_hold 0.6), drives the foot forward and down at 0.72 and rakes it back; hits from BackFoot.R
attack_heavy.note_therizinosaurus: therizinosaurus: two-arm overhead rake, 1.58 s: rears hissing with both arms high and trembling (held through windup_hold 0.6), drives both claw sets down on 0.72 and rakes back; the only move that bleeds (pipeline.status_clips)

bite_combo.note_gallimimus: gallimimus: peck-peck-kick, 2.75 s on the same fracs: pecks on 0.092 and 0.338, rears with the leg cocked (the tell, 0.5-0.667, held to 0.76), the kick on 0.815
bite_combo.note: chomp left, chomp right, MEGA chomp: the front rears up for 12 frames (frames 33-44 of 66, the tell), then the whole body tips down from the hips like an animal drinking and bites at ground level. Exaggerated on purpose (owner: big by default, tune after). tools/jaw/make_combo.py.
bite_combo.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)
bite_combo.note_therizinosaurus: therizinosaurus: hook and rake, 3.0 s on the same fracs: the right claws hook on 0.092 and drag her in (tactics.hook_pull_m), a left backhand on 0.338, rears with both arms cocked (the tell, 0.5-0.667), double claw thrust on 0.815
bite_combo.note_raptorflank: raptor (RAPTORFLANK): tools/gait/raptor_overlay.py on the transferred clip: the hands grab forward with the claws spread and rake down clenched on each hit, the tail is keyed level (it flicked straight up); same timing and events

hop_back.note_gallimimus: gallimimus: make_galli_moves.py hop_back, 0.583 s, crouch, feet tucked, squash landing
hop_back.note: 0.46 s: crouch, backward leap, landing squash; in place, the game moves the creature back during it. tools/jaw/make_hop_back.py (deinonychus first).
hop_back.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py hop_back, 0.458 s, IK-planted toes on the ground frames, jaw hisses open 10 deg
hop_back.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)
hop_back.note_pachycephalosaurus: pachycephalosaurus: tools/gait/make_pachy_moves.py hop_back, 0.583 s, crouch, feet tucked in the air, planted squash landing; played twice after every charge (PACHYBULL)

strafe_left.note: sidestep loop for every species, body keeps facing; tools/gait/make_gait.py <species>.json walk --as strafe_left --travel 1,0,0

leap_back.note_gallimimus: gallimimus: make_galli_moves.py leap_back, 0.79 s, deep crouch, legs tucked tight, nose up
leap_back.note: long backward leap, 0.79 s, wings fully flared; the game sets the distance (~5 m)
leap_back.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py leap_back, 0.667 s, deeper crouch, high tuck, nose-up landing
leap_back.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

pounce.note: ambush pounce, 0.96 s: crouch, long high forward leap nose-down, wings fully flared; the game sets the distance (owner: larger leaps, ~8-10 m from cover)
pounce.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py pounce, 0.75 s, jaws wide (28 deg) in the air, snapping shut on hit_frac 0.7, arms thrown forward
pounce.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)
pounce.note_smilodon: smilodon: tools/gait/make_cat_moves.py pounce, 1.0 s: launch from the crouch, forelegs reaching, both forepaws slam down on the prey and the sabres stab at hit_frac 0.7; a landed pounce turns into the pin (pin_stab)
pounce.note_tarbosaurus: tarbosaurus: make_rex_moves.py --tarbo pounce, 1.0 s: the burst out of the stalk, one long low bound (both feet off 0.2-0.65, the game carries the arc), jaws thrust ahead and slammed shut on 0.7; a landed burst is an attack_heavy hit, so it pins (pin_foot)
pounce.note_raptorflank: raptor (RAPTORFLANK): tools/gait/raptor_overlay.py on the transferred clip: the hands grab forward with the claws spread and rake down clenched on each hit, the tail is keyed level (it flicked straight up); same timing and events

walk_back.note: backing up: the species' own walk time-reversed (tools/reverse_clip.py), so its natural speed is the walk's; play when velocity is against facing
walk_back.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: its own backpedal loop (make_gait.py compsognathus.json strafe --as walk_back --travel 0,1,0), 0.625 s, natural_speeds.compsognathus.walk_back

dodge_left.note_gallimimus: gallimimus: make_galli_moves.py dodge_left, 0.417 s, banks into the side bound, legs tucked
dodge_left.note: explosive sideways dodge to the left, ~0.42 s: crouch, push off, body banks, wings flared, lands facing the target; in place, the game moves the creature (tools/jaw/make_hop_back.py --side left)
dodge_left.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py dodge_left, 0.417 s, banks into the jump
dodge_left.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

dodge_right.note_gallimimus: gallimimus: make_galli_moves.py dodge_right, mirror of dodge_left
dodge_right.note: explosive sideways dodge to the right, ~0.42 s: crouch, push off, body banks, wings flared, lands facing the target; in place, the game moves the creature (tools/jaw/make_hop_back.py --side right)
dodge_right.note_compsognathus: compsognathus: tools/gait/make_leap.py dodge_right, 0.417 s, banks into the jump
dodge_right.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

kick.note: herbivore defence: weight forward, both hind legs snap back and up (hit at 0.45), plant; tools/jaw/make_charge_kick.py
kick.note_tarbosaurus: tarbosaurus: the tail whip in the kick slot (make_rex_moves.py --tarbo kick: the rex tail whip retimed so the crack lands on 0.45); hit from Tail4-7

idle_cold.note: survivor state idle, loops in place of idle when cold: hunched, arms hugged, shivering. tools/make_state_idles.py (same length and fps as idle)

idle_heat.note: survivor state idle, loops in place of idle when hot: fanning the face, other hand on the hip, chin up

idle_tired.note: survivor state idle, loops in place of idle when tired: slumped shoulders, head low, slow sway

idle_exhausted.note: survivor state idle, loops in place of idle when exhausted: bent over, hands on knees, heavy breathing

charge.note_gallimimus: gallimimus: make_gait.py gallimimus.json charge, the run flattened, neck stretched forward
charge.note: charge loop, stride-matched like run. Herbivores: the run with the head dropped low, horns/frill first (make_charge_kick.py). Deinonychus: its own low sprint (tools/gait deinonychus.json clip charge, body near horizontal, wings swept back), natural ground speed 6.6 m/s = 1.49x its run
charge.note_coelomoves: coelophysis, utahraptor, velociraptor: the deinonychus clip moved onto its rig with tools/gait/transfer_clips.py --floor-feet --pin-toes (same timing and events)

bite_shake.note: T. rex signature (SP-TYRANNOSAURUS): short lunge, the jaws clamp on the hit (0.30), four head thrashes, then a fling to her left with the jaws opening; 2.5 s. tools/gait/make_rex_moves.py bite_shake. MegaRexBrain plays it from phase 2 on a target small enough to grab.

toss.note: woolly rhino horn toss, 1.0 s: starts in the charge's head-low pose and hooks the horn up through the target at 0.3; played by TacticalBrain on a charge impact (the hit is the impact, the clip is cosmetic). tools/gait/woolly_rhino/clips.py

pin_stab.note: smilodon (SP-SMILODON, tools/gait/make_cat_moves.py): 2.4 s held over pinned prey under both forepaws; the head rears with the jaws wide, then the sabres drive down at 0.38 and again at 0.74 (TacticalBrain pin, x pin_mult each, hit from the Head bone)
pin_stab.note_raptor: raptor (SP-RAPTOR, tools/gait/make_raptor_moves.py): the same 2.4 s and hits: after a landed pounce the right foot stamps onto the prey and holds it (RPR), the feathered arms flap for balance, the head rears jaws-wide and bites down at 0.38 and 0.74 (TacticalBrain pin, from the Head part)

charge_turn.note: carnotaurus: the sharp turn at the end of a straight charge, 0.71 s: plant and crouch, hop with the body banked into a LEFT turn and the tail flung wide, land squashed. In place; TacticalBrain (tactics.charge_turn) carries it on along the old line and yaws it round to the prey only inside the airborne window, so the planted feet never skid. tools/gait/make_carno_moves.py charge_turn
charge_turn.note_raptor: raptor (RAPTORFLANK, make_raptor_moves.py charge_turn, 0.71 s): the flank's skid-turn after it runs past the prey: brakes leaning back, hops with the arms flung wide and the tail lifted, lands crouched facing the prey; same airborne window, TacticalBrain flank turns the short way inside it

leap.note: smilodon (SMILORUN, tools/gait/make_cat_moves.py leap, 0.75 s): the chase bound; coil out of the stride, hinds drive off at 0.12, stretched flight, fronts land on their prints at 0.78 as the body stops, hinds swing in under the chest at 0.88. TacticalBrain tactics.bound moves the body (and lifts it over steps) inside airborne.

charge_windup.note: STYRAFIX telegraph before a horned charge (styracosaurus): horns lowered, a fore-foot paws twice, a snort; the body stands still (tools/jaw/make_styra_impale.py)

impale.note: STYRAFIX: horns dip to the ground and scoop up hard. The survivor is caught on the horn tip at hit_frac, carried up with it and flung at release_frac (TacticalBrain impale phase); feet planted

charge_recover.note: STYRAFIX: winded after a charge, head low with three decaying head shakes; the punish window (charge_recover_s)

stomp.note: ankylosaurus (ANKYLOCLOSE, tools/gait/make_tail_club.py stomp), 1.5 s: the front rears off the left forefoot, the foot hauled high and forward, held, then slammed down in front (impact 0.56); ClubTailBrain lands the hit (ai.json club_tail.close_moves.stomp: an area in front, knockdown)

shove_left.note: ankylosaurus (ANKYLOCLOSE, make_tail_club.py), 1.2 s: cocks away, then head and shoulders swing hard to its left while the body lurches over and the left forefoot steps out (impact 0.48); ClubTailBrain lands the hit (close_moves.shove_left, knockback sideways)

shove_right.note: mirror of shove_left, to its right

tackle.note: ankylosaurus (ANKYLOCLOSE, make_tail_club.py), 0.9 s: the coil before the body check (crouch, front low, head down, a forefoot paws); ClubTailBrain then runs it up to close_moves.tackle.lunge_m into her and lands the hit on contact (knockdown)

flank_rake.note: raptor (RAPTORFLANK, owner 2026-10-31: 'run past, turn, strafe, attack from behind'; make_raptor_moves.py flank_rake, 1.0 s): from behind the prey a short leap onto its back (the brain carries the arc inside airborne), both sickle feet swung forward and cocked, arms thrown forward with the hand claws spread, jaws wide; at 0.56 both feet and hands rake down through it and the jaws bite (TacticalBrain flank, x flank_mult); it rakes back and drops into its stance

smilodon._note: SP-SMILODON: walk/run from tools/bake_clip_speeds.py --dry-run; stalk, strafes and walk_back = make_gait stride / cycle x height_meters / source height (0.3/1.917, 0.3/1.25 mesh units/s x 2.0/0.5684); SMILORUN: run re-baked (bake_clip_speeds.py --dry-run) on the rotary bound; lope and sprint = make_gait stride / cycle x 2.0/0.5684 (0.77/0.75, 1.8/0.5 mesh units/s)

tarbosaurus._note: SP-TARBOSAURUS: walk/run from tools/bake_clip_speeds.py --dry-run; stalk = make_gait stride / cycle (1.6 / 2.2 rig m/s) x 6.8 / 8; strafes and walk_back reuse the walk plan

raptor._note: RAPTORFLANK 2026-10-31: the raptor's own make_gait.py gaits (tools/gait/raptor.json): ground speed = planned stride / cycle x 7.498 (game m per mesh unit at 3.5 m). Strafes and walk_back are baked so the sidestep no longer plays at the walk's speed (its feet slid ~20 %).
